verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of Obsidian's search feature, its full-text search syntax, or filter operators for tags, properties (frontmatter), or file paths. While it mentions local Markdown storage (offline access) and the Bases plugin for database-like views, none of the cited docs or community posts describe or corroborate a full-text search with tag/property/path filtering, so this applicable capability is unevidenced. Missing for 10: docs on the search pane/operators, evidence of tag:/path:/property filter syntax, and any confirmation search works fully offline.
